Mochi Penguin includes Python 3.12, Qt 6.11, PySide6 and Shiboken6 6.11,
and the PyInstaller bootloader. Their copyright and license notices are
included here and in their license subfolders. These components retain
their original licenses.

Qt and PySide use dynamically loaded libraries in _internal. You may replace
these libraries with compatible modified builds. No restriction is imposed
on reverse engineering for debugging modifications to these LGPL components.

Upstream source and build instructions:
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/?h=v6.11.0
https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git/?h=v6.11.0
https://www.python.org/downloads/source/
https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/tree/v6.16.0

The application source and entry point are in the bundled Source folder.
